flagged.why: Washington State Lottery's AI-powered site generated an inappropriate image directly for/of a user during interaction.
WHO's SARAH chatbot, a deployed conversational health advisor, gave inconsistent and inadequate/harmful responses to users, including on mental health crises.
Google's AI search/chat feature gave confidently incorrect and harmful answers (e.g., glue on pizza) directly to users' queries.
Legal AI research assistants (Lexis+ AI, Westlaw AI-Assisted Research), used directly by legal professionals, hallucinated in response to queries.
